title: Adamant
description: This mod adds a brand‑new ore: Adamant. Discover its rare veins underground and craft powerful Adamant tools with increased durability and efficiency. No armor included — this mod focuses purely on mining and tool progression
body:
Adamant Expansion brings a brand‑new ore to your Minecraft world: Adamant, a rare and powerful material designed to enrich your mining progression while staying true to the vanilla experience.
Adamant ore generates deep underground in small, valuable veins. Once collected and refined, it can be used to craft a complete set of Adamant tools. These tools offer increased durability, faster mining speed, and improved efficiency compared to standard materials, giving players a meaningful upgrade without disrupting game balance.
This mod is intentionally lightweight and focused. It enhances exploration, mining, and tool progression without adding unnecessary complexity. Whether you're starting a fresh world or expanding an existing adventure, Adamant provides a new incentive to dig deeper and push your resource‑gathering further.
Features
- Adds a new ore: Adamant
- Naturally generates in the world
- Craftable Adamant tools (pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe, sword)
- Higher durability and efficiency than vanilla materials
- Balanced progression that fits seamlessly into the base game
- Lightweight and fully vanilla‑friendly
If you want a simple yet rewarding addition that expands your mining journey, Adamant Expansion is the perfect choice.
